summary_1line: Arjuna destroys the Nivatakavachas and the aerial city Hiranyapura, wielding divine weapons including the Raudra, earning Indra’s praise.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna releases the Raudra weapon as a three‑headed, nine‑eyed fiery being manifests and countless monstrous forms flood the battlefield.
The jewel‑studded aerial city Hiranyapura glides through sky, water, and earth while Arjuna’s arrows batter its shining towers.
After the battle, the disheveled wives of the slain Asuras rush from the shattered city, crying and beating their breasts amid fallen ornaments.
